notes: NuVo control pad menus: a ready-made Reboot folder with two items, Restart Fenix and Reboot server, each asking Yes/No first. Helper items no longer need Python installed beforehand: when none is found, the Helper items section offers to install Python from python.org (the right version for this Windows, 32-bit or 64-bit). Typing a helper item by hand is checked more clearly. In this release the menus are saved only; the control pads keep their current menus.
